duster.headline: Diesel autos cluster R195k-R260k; 2022 TechRoad Auto (28741951) fits every criterion; manual Zen 28729328 is the price standout; multi-franchise stores suit your trade-in.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249 900/47 051 km, +R12 185 - only 2020+ diesel auto under R250k.
2022 Zen diesel, R209 990/72 000 km, +R24 273 - biggest bargain, but manual.
2019 Dynamique Auto diesel, R195 000/88 500 km, +R5 717 - cheapest diesel auto, pre-2020.

alerts: 28729328 undercuts comparable 2022 diesel autos by ~R40k - verify service history and accident record before committing.

caddy.headline: Thin market: single listing - 2020 1.6 Crew Bus R279 990/76 000 km, under both caps; Kombi-style crew cab, verify mechanicals thoroughly.

shortlist.note: Only option: 2020 Crew Bus, R279 990/76 000 km, petrol manual - crew-cab Kombi type; full inspection essential.

jimny.headline: All three fit caps and are 3-door (no 5-doors listed); cheapest viable is 2018 1.3 at R234 890/86 000 km; low-km 2021 is private - verify.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3, R234 890/86 000 km, manual - older gen; budget for checks/tyres.
2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, R289 890/78 000 km - newer gen, dealer-sold, safer buy.
2021 GLX, R295 995/25 115 km - lowest km but no dealer listed; verify carefully.

seltos.headline: Strong value: 2021 EX Auto R210 000 (+R37.7k) tops the list; manual EX R189 900 (+R44.9k) if auto waived; multi-franchise stores suit the Duster trade.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210 000/100 000 km, +R37 692 - best auto value; confirm FSH at km milestone.
2021 1.6 EX, R189 900/93 800 km, +R44 930 - biggest discount but manual; Bidvest is trade-friendly.
2022 1.6 EX+ Auto, R234 900/97 876 km, +R13 700 - Durban Multifranchise, ideal for the trade-in.

alerts: 28564368 sits exactly on 100 000 km - verify full service history before banking the +R37.7k value gap.

creta.headline: Diesel autos sit R250k-R270k; 2024 Premium Auto (28730217, +R26.4k) is the value pick; flag the 2021 '1.6D' as probable gen1 (400 L boot).

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto, R279 999/40 000 km, +R26 362 - near-new value; verify why so cheap.
2021 1.5D Executive Auto, R269 990/60 099 km, +R426 - gen2 diesel auto, 433 L boot, fair.
2021 1.5D Executive Auto, R269 900/70 000 km - gen2 diesel auto; GWM Haval Mobeni takes the trade.

alerts: 28479041 '2021 1.6D Executive' looks like gen1 (1.6 motor, 400 L boot) - confirm generation before chasing the +R15 779.

hr-v.headline: Two old-gen CVT autos with 448 L boots and Magic Seats; 2021 Comfort at R249 990/57 000 km is the clear pick; no hybrids listed.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.5 Comfort CVT, R249 990/57 000 km - old gen, 448 L boot + Magic Seats.
2020 1.8 Elegance CVT, R298 900/50 000 km - more power/spec but R49k dearer.

corolla-cross.headline: Baseline captured: 14 listings, all petrol CVT, no hybrids; value benchmark is 2021 XS at R249 990/36 300 km (+R20.2k); expect alerts next run.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.8 XS, R249 990/36 300 km, +R20 200 - best spec-per-rand, low km.
2024 1.8 XS, R269 999/42 342 km, +R17 109 - near-new XS at Xi money.
2021 XS, R249 999/29 000 km, +R17 488 - suspiciously cheap; verify history carefully.
